title: Adds expired status for Issuing Authorizations
changed: authorizations expired by Stripe move from reversed to expired

parts.how: Only with fullDiff: compareOpenApi lists Stripe response enum additions as compatible (openResponseEnums), and switchedEnumAdditions (openapi-diff.ts) adds a blocking entry for the new value where traced code switches over the field, assigns it to `never`, or compares it with string literals (`===`, `!==`, `==`, `!=` or `['a'].includes(...)`; analyzer.ts enumChecks, owner decision 6). unmappedBreakingChanges keeps that entry, so scanReviewReason (workflow.ts) stops the run for review and publication is blocked. Other reads need no edit. Without fullDiff nothing is reported.

changed: authorizations expired by Stripe move from reversed to expired
parts.how: Only with fullDiff, and only because the same release adds `expired` to the field: a compare with the old value (`x.field === <old value>`, `!==`, `==`, `!=` or `['a'].includes(...)`) is an enumCheck since owner decision 6 (analyzer.ts), so switchedEnumAdditions (openapi-diff.ts) reports the added values there and scanReviewReason (workflow.ts) stops the run for review. The entry names the added values, not the replaced one; reads that do not compare or switch are not reported. Without fullDiff nothing is reported.
